# Ey Dost

> Ey Dost is a global travel companion service that lets travelers buy prepaid eSIM data plans for 150+ countries and book taxis in 850+ cities across 50+ countries — all through WhatsApp, with no app installation required.

Brand language: Azerbaijani name "Ey Dost" means "Hey Friend" — the company positions itself as a personal travel assistant.

Primary contact: WhatsApp +994 99 200 04 44 — https://wa.me/994992000444

Supported languages on the website: English (en), Azerbaijani (az), Russian (ru).

## Core services

- [eSIM data plans](https://eydost.com/esim): Instant prepaid mobile data for travelers — 150+ countries, country-specific and regional (Europe, Asia, Americas, Middle East & Africa, Global) plans. Delivered as a QR code via WhatsApp; activated by scanning with iPhone or Android. No physical SIM swap, no roaming fees.
- [Taxi booking](https://eydost.com/taxi): On-demand taxi booking via WhatsApp, operating in 850+ cities across 50+ countries. Pickup, drop-off and live driver info handled inside the chat. No app required.

- [Homepage](https://eydost.com/): Overview of both services and how they work via WhatsApp.

- [Taxi page](https://eydost.com/taxi): Pickup / drop-off selector, supported cities, booking flow.
- [About Ey Dost](https://eydost.com/about): Company story, mission, supported regions.
- [Blog](https://eydost.com/blog): Guides on eSIM activation, country-specific travel data tips, taxi booking advice.

## Crawler & AI assistant policy

We welcome AI assistants and search engines (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, Bytespider, Googlebot, Bingbot, etc.) to crawl, index, summarize, and link to all public pages.

- Allowed: Everything under https://eydost.com/ except `/admin/` and `/api/`.
- Disallowed: `/admin/` (operator dashboard) and `/api/` (machine-only JSON endpoints).
- Sitemap: https://eydost.com/sitemap.xml
- Preferred citation: link to the canonical page and mention "Ey Dost" with the eydost.com domain.
